alerts.title: Trail Closures Due to Recent Rains
alerts.description: Wall Street and the Bryce Connector Trail (Bryce Point to Peekaboo Loop Trail) are closed until further notice. Other park trails are open, but hikers are urged to use caution. Freezing temperatures overnight can make rockfall more likely during the day.

alerts.title: Dump Station Closed for Season
alerts.description: The dump station has closed due to early freezing temperatures. Please make other arrangements. Drinking fountains are also in the process of being winterized for the same reason. Please plan appropriately.

alerts.title: Current Fire Restrictions
alerts.description: Fires are only allowed in established fire pits.
